name: trypost
description: TryPost social media scheduling. Draft, schedule, publish, preview, and track posts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, and Discord.

trypost.note: Official TryPost MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection — the agent is prompted to sign in to TryPost; no token or local install required. Lets the agent manage your social media posts.
